text:
Maria: Heads up — pen test kickoff next Tue (09:00 PST). Need a short ops checklist: RBAC changes, KMS access for assessors, audit-log retention sampling, and retest slots. Can folks confirm what we need and owners?
Ajay: tagging in. Which environments are in scope? prod/staging/readonly?
Maria: Scope: staging + a read-only slice of prod observability (logs only). No writes to prod.
Devon: ok. For RBAC we usually create ephemeral assessor role scoped to `assessor/*` and timebox to the window. Need exact ARNs & expiration policy.
Priya: +1. Also need KMS decrypt grants for evidence bundles. We should avoid sharing customer keys; create a dedicated KMS key alias `alias/pt-evidence` with grants limited to the assessor principal.
Sam: timeline: planning call Mon EOD, dry-run Tue 07:00, live Tue 09:00, retest Fri 13:00-15:00. Is that workable?
Maria: sounds good. Can we auto-provision ephemeral role and presigned S3 for evidence upload? That reduces manual hand-offs.
Ajay: we have an automation script. Sample IAM assume-role policy we give to assessors:```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
    "Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-ephemeral"
  }]
}
```
Devon: also need KMS grant command (ops-run):```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-ephemeral --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "pt-assessor-grant"
```
Priya: make sure grants are tracked and auto-revoked post-window. Our script can revoke by tag `pt-window=<ts>`.
Maria: audit logs — we need sampling plan and retention. Compliance wants a 30-day bucket for raw logs and 90-day for parsed alerts; we can export to our SIEM.
Devon: recommend we export CloudTrail + application request logs to a read-only bucket with path `pen-tests/1799997777/`. Provide presigned PUT URLs with 6h expiry for evidence.
Sam: who owns the presigned link generation? Ajay?
Ajay: I can run the generator. Example:```python
# generate presigned
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'rw-pt-evidence','Key':'pen-tests/1799997777/evidence.zip'}, ExpiresIn=21600)
print(url)
```
Maria: perfect. Also need a minimal runbook with escalation steps if assessors request higher access. Keep escalation contact list & approval steps.
Priya: agree. Add checklist: pre-window smoke, key-grant, role-assume test, log-export verification, snapshot hash recorded.
secops-bot: Jira ticket created: RW-PT-2026-1799997777 (pen-test: ephemeral roles + evidence pipeline). Assigned to Ajay, Priya.
Sam: retest coordination — please add available 30m slots Fri 13:00-15:00 in the calendar and mark on the ticket.
Ajay: will update ticket + push automation branch with grant/revoke scripts. PR ping here when ready. :rocket:
Devon: I'll add the log-collector lambda to the automation branch and include verification `sha256` checks.
Maria: thanks all. Action items: Ajay (presigned + IAM role), Priya (KMS key & revoke policy), Devon (log collector + hashes), Sam (calendar + runbook). We'll do a 30m dry-run Tue 07:00.
Sam: noted. See you on Mon call to finalize. :thumbsup:
